kata.name: State-discovery unreachable state - Buffering has an exit but no entry; the kernel raises no reachability finding (null result)
kata.series_report: docs/ref/ploeh-grounding.md §6 candidate 4 (reverse state-machine kata); fixtures/katas/state-discovery/README.md (pre-registered); beads catherine-lgl.4
kata.series_verdict: pre-registered null result: reachability has no finding surface; check emits nothing, underconstraint's two questions are schema-level, and the frozen baseline protocol is cell assertions only, so the entry is killed

expected.detail: Buffering is declared with an outgoing ready edge but no incoming transition; no kernel surface emits a reachability finding. The pre-registered outcome is a recorded observation and gap, not a fabricated finding
underconstraint raises cell_state vs cell_target and from vs to as hypothesized questions unrelated to reachability; recorded with the hypothesized label

commands: python3 prototype/state_discovery_baseline.py --assert  # exit 0: all seven sampled cells pass; unreachable observation recorded
cargo run -q -p catherine-cli -- check fixtures/katas/state-discovery/unreachable.ct.json --json  # exit 0, findings []
cargo run -q -p catherine-cli -- underconstraint fixtures/katas/state-discovery/unreachable.ct.json --max-path-length 1 --json  # exit 6, 2 hypothesized findings

comparison.conventional_baseline: the frozen sample covers all seven cells and every assertion passes; the baseline protocol is cell assertions only, so it does not run a reachability BFS and identifies no unavailable state.

baseline.artifact: prototype/state_discovery_baseline.py sha256:7d98b54bb65ea4e4c00962fc1d0e3e57ce19acb134f5d767b1177badd11fec3e (frozen transition-table sample; always executed before the probe arm)

expressibility_gap.invariant: every declared state is reachable from the initial state
expressibility_gap.why: the kernel has no reachability/closure finding; the model has no State->State arrow, so even `query` cannot close the state graph. The observation is recorded (Buffering unreachable), never claimed as a finding

discrepancies: A conventional reachability BFS would name Buffering. The frozen baseline protocol is cell assertions only and the probe arm emits no reachability finding, so both arms are silent: a null result, not a probe advantage and not parity-as-victory.
procedure: 1. The fault set and its expectations were committed in fixtures/katas/state-discovery/ before any recorded run (README.md, faults.json); nothing here is edited after the run.

2. The baseline arm (prototype/state_discovery_baseline.py, sha256 above) was executed first: frozen per-fixture samples of (state,event) cells asserting cell->transition, source/event/target agreement. Cells outside the sample are never inspected.

3. The probe arm ran the same fixtures through the real CLI: `catherine check --json`, plus `catherine underconstraint --max-path-length 1 --json` where the discovery questions belong to the entry; the construction probe is the same binary refusing an unparseable document.

4. Witnesses were mapped to presentation elements cell:<State>/<Event>; unique_detections = executed probe elements minus baseline-identified elements. Hypothesized underconstraint findings and executed construction rejections are recorded but never counted as detections.
5. Verdict follows the recorded rule: empty unique = killed; unique with an executed baseline arm = survived.
